page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Hebrew line at top; then the title block in capitals and italics; an engraving (two angels holding an open book, a phoenix above) in the centre; imprint below the engraving. Handwritten ownership note at the right, outside the text block.

main_text.l: Ecclesiæ Gallo-Belgicæ Pastore, S. Theol. & Phil.
IMMORTALITATIS (engraved book, the words IM / MOR / TA and LI / TA / TI)

page.notes: The engraving shows two angels holding an open book inscribed IM/MOR/TA and LI/TA/TI (Immortalitatis), with a phoenix in flames above. Handwritten ownership note at the right margin, in ink: "Ad Conv. Monae. Ord. Premonst. S. Augustini." (read approximately; not transcribed as print). The Hebrew line is printed as a title element and is copied in Hebrew letters. Some words in the imprint and engraving are read with uncertainty.
